INSTRUMENT NOT BUILT, AND IT IS EXPECTED TO LAND RED. What it must do: change a skill's `scripts/` WITHOUT touching its `SKILL.md`, sync, and establish that the change reached the installed tree. The checksum covers `SKILL.md` alone, so the sync reports a clean run and the script does not propagate -- the criterion is not satisfied today and the row should not be minted green by a test that avoids the case. THE FIXTURE ALREADY EXISTS: `intentsvcs/tests/skills_sync.rs` carries a disposable install tree, Claude target and manifest, which is where `AT-00.5` was driven. THE SECOND INSTANCE, THE `$N` STRIP, NEEDS ITS OWN ARM: a `SKILL.md` carrying an `awk` field reference must arrive at the machine with that reference intact, and today it arrives as an empty pipeline. BOTH ARMS ARE THE SAME MECHANISM -- the source is right, the surface reports success, and the delivered thing differs -- so they belong to one row. The stranding is the third instance and lives in `AC-00.5`, not here.
BUILT 2026-09-02 AND GREEN, NOT RED -- THE PREMISE ABOVE IS REFUTED AND THAT IS THE FINDING. The note above says the checksum covers SKILL.md alone so a script-only change never propagates, and that the row was therefore expected to land red. DRIVEN IN THE FIXTURE: it propagates. Install a skill with a `scripts/go.sh`, change ONLY the script in canon, sync -- outcome `Updated { written: 2 }` and the installed script reads the new bytes. `Payload::unit_checksum` dispatches on the payload's SHAPE and a skill is `Shape::Tree`, so the checksum is `tree_checksum(dir)` over the whole directory, `scripts/` included.

THE BLIND SPOT IS A v2-ERA CLAIM THAT READS IDENTICALLY AFTER IT STOPPED BEING TRUE. I carried it into the criterion from an older note without re-driving it -- which is watch-out 13's class arriving INSIDE the row written to catch that very family, and the second time today a premise of mine expired between being written and being used.

WHAT THE INSTRUMENT ASSERTS INSTEAD, at `native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/tests/skills_sync.rs`: a change below SKILL.md reaches the machine, read back from the TARGET rather than from sync's own report, which is the whole of AC-00.6. AND THE CONTROL COMES FIRST BECAUSE IT IS WHAT STOPS THE PROPAGATION ARM PASSING VACUOUSLY: an UNCHANGED source must report `UpToDate`, since a sync that rewrote every file unconditionally would satisfy propagation and tell nobody anything.

THE CRITERION'S OTHER CITED INSTANCE IS OUT OF REACH, NOT PASSING: the skill renderer stripping `$N` is a CONSUMER's behaviour on a file Intent has already delivered intact, so no test here can see it. So AC-00.6's mechanism is real and its live instance is the three-location stranding, which AC-00.5 owns. RAISED WITH vc: the row may want its cited instances corrected, since one is refuted and one is outside anything Intent delivers.
